class CssStereo extends android.widget.FrameLayout {
boolean on = false;
int sep = 0;
CssStereo(android.content.Context c) { super(c); setWillNotDraw(false); }
@Override
protected void onMeasure(int w, int h) {
if (on && getChildCount() > 0) {
int W = android.view.View.MeasureSpec.getSize(w), H = android.view.View.MeasureSpec.getSize(h);
for (int i = 0; i < getChildCount(); i++) getChildAt(i).measure(android.view.View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(W / 2, android.view.View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY), android.view.View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(H, android.view.View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
setMeasuredDimension(W, H);
} else super.onMeasure(w, h);
}
@Override
protected void onLayout(boolean ch, int l, int t, int r, int b) {
if (on && getChildCount() > 0) { for (int i = 0; i < getChildCount(); i++) getChildAt(i).layout(0, 0, (r - l) / 2, b - t); }
else super.onLayout(ch, l, t, r, b);
}
@Override
protected void dispatchDraw(android.graphics.Canvas c) {

}
android.view.MotionEvent map(android.view.MotionEvent e) {

m.offsetLocation(e.getX() >= h2 ? -(h2 - sep) : -sep, 0);
return m;
}
@Override
public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(android.view.MotionEvent e) {
if (!on || getChildCount() == 0) return super.dispatchTouchEvent(e);
android.view.MotionEvent m = map(e);

m.recycle();
return r;
}

class CssFiles {

}

}

/* grava na pasta Downloads; devolve "ok:Downloads/nome|endereço" ou "err:motivo" */
String saveDl(String name, String mime, byte[] data) {
try {
String safe = safeName(name);
if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
android.content.ContentValues cv = new android.content.ContentValues();
cv.put(android.provider.MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME, safe);
cv.put(android.provider.MediaStore.MediaColumns.MIME_TYPE, mimeOf(mime));
cv.put(android.provider.MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH, android.os.Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS);
android.net.Uri uri = getContentResolver().insert(android.provider.MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, cv);
if (uri == null) return "err:uri";
java.io.OutputStream os = getContentResolver().openOutputStream(uri);
if (os == null) return "err:stream";
os.write(data);
os.close();
return "ok:Downloads/" + safe + "|" + uri.toString();
}
if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 23 && checkSelfPermission(android.Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) != android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
runOnUiThread(new Runnable() {
public void run() {
requestPermissions(new String[]{android.Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE}, 1114);
}
});
return "err:perm";
}
java.io.File dir = android.os.Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(android.os.Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS);
if (!dir.exists()) dir.mkdirs();
java.io.File f = new java.io.File(dir, safe);
int k = 2;
String base = safe.replaceAll("(\\.[^.]*)$", "");
String ext = safe.length() > base.length() ? safe.substring(base.length()) : "";
while (f.exists()) {
f = new java.io.File(dir, base + " (" + k + ")" + ext);
k++;
}
java.io.FileOutputStream fo = new java.io.FileOutputStream(f);
fo.write(data);
fo.close();
android.media.MediaScannerConnection.scanFile(MainActivity.this, new String[]{f.getAbsolutePath()}, new String[]{mimeOf(mime)}, null);
return "ok:Downloads/" + f.getName() + "|file:" + f.getAbsolutePath();
} catch (Exception e) {
return "err:" + e.getMessage();
}
}
/* transforma o endereço devolvido por saveDl em content:// para abrir/compartilhar */
void withUri(String token, String mime, final CssUriCb cb) {
if (token == null || token.length() == 0) {
cb.got(null);
return;
}
if (token.startsWith("content:")) {
cb.got(android.net.Uri.parse(token));
return;
}
String path = token.startsWith("file:") ? token.substring(5) : token;
android.media.MediaScannerConnection.scanFile(MainActivity.this, new String[]{path}, new String[]{mimeOf(mime)},
new android.media.MediaScannerConnection.OnScanCompletedListener() {
public void onScanCompleted(String p, final android.net.Uri uri) {
runOnUiThread(new Runnable() {
public void run() {
cb.got(uri);
}
});
}
});
}

void cssCamTransform(int pw, int ph) {
try {
int vw = cssCamTv.getWidth(), vh = cssCamTv.getHeight();
if (vw == 0 || vh == 0) return;
int rot = getWindowManager().getDefaultDisplay().getRotation();
android.graphics.Matrix m = new android.graphics.Matrix();
android.graphics.RectF view = new android.graphics.RectF(0, 0, vw, vh);
float cx = view.centerX(), cy = view.centerY();
if (rot == android.view.Surface.ROTATION_90 || rot == android.view.Surface.ROTATION_270) {
android.graphics.RectF buf = new android.graphics.RectF(0, 0, ph, pw);
buf.offset(cx - buf.centerX(), cy - buf.centerY());
m.setRectToRect(view, buf, android.graphics.Matrix.ScaleToFit.FILL);
float sc = Math.max((float) vh / ph, (float) vw / pw);
m.postScale(sc, sc, cx, cy);
m.postRotate(90 * (rot - 2), cx, cy);
} else {
/* retrato: a imagem vem deitada; ajusta para cobrir a tela */
float bw = ph, bh = pw;
float sc = Math.max(vw / bw, vh / bh);
m.setScale(bw * sc / vw, bh * sc / vh, cx, cy);
if (rot == android.view.Surface.ROTATION_180) m.postRotate(180, cx, cy);
}
cssCamTv.setTransform(m);
} catch (Exception e) { }
}

@Override

@android.webkit.JavascriptInterface
public String camOpen(final String opts) {
/* V170: escolhe a lente de maior ângulo e abre a câmera por trás do app */
try {
if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 23 && checkSelfPermission(android.Manifest.permission.CAMERA) != android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
runOnUiThread(new Runnable() { public void run() { try { requestPermissions(new String[]{android.Manifest.permission.CAMERA}, 7170); } catch (Exception e) { } } });
return "{\"ok\":false,\"err\":\"perm\"}";
}
boolean wide = opts == null || opts.indexOf("wide") >= 0, max = opts != null && opts.indexOf("max") >= 0;
android.hardware.camera2.CameraManager cm = (android.hardware.camera2.CameraManager) getSystemService(android.content.Context.CAMERA_SERVICE);
/* V179: todas as formas de abrir cada lente traseira; escolhe a de maior ângulo (ou a que a pessoa escolheu) */
java.util.ArrayList<String[]> L = cssLenses(cm);
if (L.isEmpty()) return "{\"ok\":false,\"err\":\"none\"}";
boolean noPhys = opts != null && opts.indexOf("nophys") >= 0, noZoom = opts != null && opts.indexOf("nozoom") >= 0;
String want = "";
if (opts != null && opts.indexOf("lens=") >= 0) { want = opts.substring(opts.indexOf("lens=") + 5); int cut = want.indexOf(','); if (cut >= 0) want = want.substring(0, cut); }
String[] pick = null;
for (String[] c : L) if (c[0].equals(want)) pick = c;
if (pick == null) {
float bh = -1, mh = 1e9f;
for (String[] c : L) {
if (noPhys && "physical".equals(c[5])) continue;
if (noZoom && "zoom".equals(c[5])) continue;
float h = Float.parseFloat(c[4]);
if (wide) { if (h > bh) { bh = h; pick = c; } }
else if ("main".equals(c[5]) && pick == null) pick = c;
}
if (pick == null) pick = L.get(0);
}
String camId = pick[1], physId = pick[2], mode = pick[5];
float zoom = Float.parseFloat(pick[3]), hfov = Float.parseFloat(pick[4]);
/* tamanho da imagem: o maior 16:9 até HD (ou até Full HD em "Máxima") */
boolean hd = opts != null && opts.indexOf("hd") >= 0;
int lim = max ? 1920 : hd ? 1280 : 960, pw = 960, ph = 540;
try {
android.hardware.camera2.params.StreamConfigurationMap map = cm.getCameraCharacteristics(physId.length() > 0 ? physId : camId).get(android.hardware.camera2.CameraCharacteristics.SCALER_STREAM_CONFIGURATION_MAP);
if (map == null) map = cm.getCameraCharacteristics(camId).get(android.hardware.camera2.CameraCharacteristics.SCALER_STREAM_CONFIGURATION_MAP);
int bw = 0;
for (android.util.Size z : map.getOutputSizes(android.graphics.ImageFormat.YUV_420_888)) {
if (z.getWidth() * 9 == z.getHeight() * 16 && z.getWidth() <= lim && z.getWidth() > bw) { bw = z.getWidth(); pw = z.getWidth(); ph = z.getHeight(); }
}
} catch (Exception e) { }
cssCamSel[0] = camId; cssCamSel[1] = physId; cssCamSel[2] = String.valueOf(zoom); cssCamSel[3] = String.valueOf(pw); cssCamSel[4] = String.valueOf(ph); cssCamSel[5] = mode; cssCamSel[6] = "opening"; cssCamSel[7] = ""; cssCamSel[8] = "0"; cssTexN[0] = 0;
runOnUiThread(new Runnable() {
public void run() {
try { camCloseNow(); cssCamTv.setVisibility(android.view.View.GONE); cssCamStart(); } catch (Exception e) { cssCamSel[6] = "err"; cssCamSel[7] = "ui"; }
}
});
return "{\"ok\":true,\"mode\":\"" + mode + "\",\"key\":\"" + pick[0] + "\",\"hfov\":" + hfov + ",\"w\":" + pw + ",\"h\":" + ph + ",\"zoom\":" + zoom + "}";
} catch (Exception e) { return "{\"ok\":false,\"err\":\"err\"}"; }
}
/* V179: lista de lentes traseiras: [chave, câmera, lente física, zoom, ângulo, modo] */
java.util.ArrayList<String[]> cssLenses(android.hardware.camera2.CameraManager cm) {
java.util.ArrayList<String[]> L = new java.util.ArrayList<String[]>();
try {
for (String id : cm.getCameraIdList()) {
android.hardware.camera2.CameraCharacteristics ch = cm.getCameraCharacteristics(id);
Integer fc = ch.get(android.hardware.camera2.CameraCharacteristics.LENS_FACING);
if (fc == null || fc.intValue() != android.hardware.camera2.CameraCharacteristics.LENS_FACING_BACK) continue;
float hMin = cssHfov(ch), z0 = 1f;
if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 30) {
android.util.Range<Float> zr = ch.get(android.hardware.camera2.CameraCharacteristics.CONTROL_ZOOM_RATIO_RANGE);
if (zr != null && zr.getLower() < 0.99f) z0 = zr.getLower();
}
if (z0 < 0.99f) {
/* câmera lógica com zoom abaixo de 1x: 1x é a principal; o zoom mínimo (0,5x/0,6x) é a ultra wide */
float hMain = (float) Math.toDegrees(2 * Math.atan(Math.tan(Math.toRadians(hMin / 2)) * z0));
L.add(new String[]{"main:" + id, id, "", "1", String.valueOf(hMain), "main"});
L.add(new String[]{"zoom:" + id, id, "", String.valueOf(z0), String.valueOf(hMin), "zoom"});
} else {
L.add(new String[]{"cam:" + id, id, "", "1", String.valueOf(hMin), hMin >= 95 ? "wide" : "main"});
}
if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 28) {
for (String pid : ch.getPhysicalCameraIds()) {
try { float h2 = cssHfov(cm.getCameraCharacteristics(pid)); L.add(new String[]{"phys:" + id + ":" + pid, id, pid, "1", String.valueOf(h2), "physical"}); } catch (Exception e) { }
}
}
}
} catch (Exception e) { }
return L;
}
@android.webkit.JavascriptInterface
public String lenses() {
org.json.JSONArray a = new org.json.JSONArray();
try {
android.hardware.camera2.CameraManager cm = (android.hardware.camera2.CameraManager) getSystemService(android.content.Context.CAMERA_SERVICE);
for (String[] c : cssLenses(cm)) { org.json.JSONObject o = new org.json.JSONObject(); o.put("key", c[0]); o.put("zoom", Double.parseDouble(c[3])); o.put("hfov", Double.parseDouble(c[4])); o.put("mode", c[5]); a.put(o); }
} catch (Exception e) { }
return a.toString();
}
float cssHfov(android.hardware.camera2.CameraCharacteristics ch) {
try {

runOnUiThread(new Runnable() { public void run() { try { cssSrMake(); } catch (Exception e) { } } });
return "ok";
} catch (Exception e) { return "err"; }
}

@android.webkit.JavascriptInterface
public String battery() {
/* V167: bateria para o widget do Espaço AR: nível, carregando (1/0) e temperatura em °C */
try {
android.content.Intent bi = registerReceiver(null, new android.content.IntentFilter(android.content.Intent.ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED));
if (bi == null) return "";
int lv = bi.getIntExtra(android.os.BatteryManager.EXTRA_LEVEL, -1), sc = bi.getIntExtra(android.os.BatteryManager.EXTRA_SCALE, 100);
int stt = bi.getIntExtra(android.os.BatteryManager.EXTRA_STATUS, -1), tp = bi.getIntExtra(android.os.BatteryManager.EXTRA_TEMPERATURE, -10000);
boolean ch = stt == android.os.BatteryManager.BATTERY_STATUS_CHARGING || stt == android.os.BatteryManager.BATTERY_STATUS_FULL;
if (lv < 0) return "";
return Math.round(lv * 100f / Math.max(1, sc)) + "," + (ch ? "1" : "0") + "," + (tp > -10000 ? String.valueOf(tp / 10f) : "");
} catch (Exception e) { return ""; }
}

@android.webkit.JavascriptInterface
public String keepOn(final String on) {
runOnUiThread(new Runnable() {
public void run() {
if ("1".equals(on)) getWindow().addFlags(android.view.WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON);
else getWindow().clearFlags(android.view.WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON);
}
});
return "ok";
}

/* V180: entrega os quadros da câmera nativa como imagem para a página (mais leve que passar texto pela ponte) */
binding.webview1.setWebViewClient(new android.webkit.WebViewClient() {
@Override
public android.webkit.WebResourceResponse shouldInterceptRequest(android.webkit.WebView view, android.webkit.WebResourceRequest req) {
try { String u = req.getUrl().toString(); if (u.startsWith("https://cssstudiopro.local/__cam/")) return cssFiles.camResp(u);
if (u.startsWith("https://cssstudiopro.local/__tts/")) return cssFiles.ttsResp(u);
/* V182: página de app (janela do AR) */
if (cssAppsOn[0] && !req.isForMainFrame() && "GET".equalsIgnoreCase(req.getMethod()) && (u.startsWith("https://") || u.startsWith("http://")) && !u.startsWith("https://cssstudiopro.local/")) {
String acc = null; for (java.util.Map.Entry<String, String> h : req.getRequestHeaders().entrySet()) if (h.getKey() != null && h.getKey().equalsIgnoreCase("Accept")) acc = h.getValue();
if (acc != null && acc.contains("text/html")) { android.webkit.WebResourceResponse r = cssFiles.webDoc(u, req.getRequestHeaders()); if (r != null) return r; }
}
} catch (Exception e) { }
return super.shouldInterceptRequest(view, req);
}
/* V182: com apps abertos no AR, um link que tentaria trocar a página inteira abre numa janela do AR */
@Override
public boolean shouldOverrideUrlLoading(android.webkit.WebView view, android.webkit.WebResourceRequest req) {
try { String u = req.getUrl().toString(); if (cssAppsOn[0] && req.isForMainFrame() && !u.startsWith("https://cssstudiopro.local/") && (u.startsWith("http://") || u.startsWith("https://"))) { view.evaluateJavascript("window.cssApps&&cssApps.fromTop(" + org.json.JSONObject.quote(u) + ")", null); return true; } } catch (Exception e) { }
return false;
}
});
/* V142 (v142back): o botão voltar do Android navega dentro do app — fecha folhas e janelas e volta para a
   última tela usada. Só quando não há mais para onde voltar o app vai para segundo plano (não fecha). */
getOnBackPressedDispatcher().addCallback(this, new androidx.activity.OnBackPressedCallback(true) {
@Override
public void handleOnBackPressed() {
try {
binding.webview1.evaluateJavascript("(function(){try{return window.__cssBack&&window.__cssBack()?'1':'0';}catch(e){return '0';}})()", new android.webkit.ValueCallback<String>() {
@Override
public void onReceiveValue(String v) {
if (v == null || v.indexOf('1') < 0) moveTaskToBack(true);
}
});
} catch (Throwable e) {
moveTaskToBack(true);
}
}
});

/* V114: qualquer download que escape da ponte (prévias, sites publicados, links) também é salvo */
binding.webview1.setDownloadListener(new android.webkit.DownloadListener() {
public void onDownloadStart(String url, String userAgent, String contentDisposition, String mimetype, long contentLength) {
String name = android.webkit.URLUtil.guessFileName(url, contentDisposition, mimetype);
try {
if (url.startsWith("blob:")) {
cssFiles.js("window.__cssNative&&__cssNative.blob(" + org.json.JSONObject.quote(url) + "," + org.json.JSONObject.quote(name) + "," + org.json.JSONObject.quote(mimetype == null ? "" : mimetype) + ")");
} else if (url.startsWith("data:")) {
int c = url.indexOf(',');
String head = url.substring(5, c);
String body = url.substring(c + 1);
boolean b64 = head.endsWith(";base64");
String mime = b64 ? head.substring(0, head.length() - 7) : head;
byte[] data = b64 ? android.util.Base64.decode(body, android.util.Base64.DEFAULT) : java.net.URLDecoder.decode(body, "UTF-8").getBytes("UTF-8");
String r = cssFiles.saveDl(name, mime, data);
cssFiles.js("window.__cssNative&&__cssNative.saved(" + org.json.JSONObject.quote(name) + "," + org.json.JSONObject.quote(cssFiles.mimeOf(mime)) + "," + org.json.JSONObject.quote(r) + ")");
} else {
android.app.DownloadManager dm = (android.app.DownloadManager) getSystemService(android.content.Context.DOWNLOAD_SERVICE);
android.app.DownloadManager.Request rq = new android.app.DownloadManager.Request(android.net.Uri.parse(url));
rq.setMimeType(mimetype);
rq.setNotificationVisibility(android.app.DownloadManager.Request.VISIBILITY_VISIBLE_NOTIFY_COMPLETED);
rq.setDestinationInExternalPublicDir(android.os.Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS, name);
dm.enqueue(rq);
cssFiles.js("window.__cssNative&&__cssNative.msg('dl')");
}
} catch (Exception e) {
cssFiles.js("window.__cssNative&&__cssNative.msg('err')");
}
}
});

binding.webview1.loadDataWithBaseURL("https://cssstudiopro.local/", html, "text/html", "UTF-8", null);
